title: Angleton and Reuben Efron's mail intercept on Oswald

tellings.quote: Ruben Efron is in the in the files and they ask him about do you know Ruben Efron and he says no that's a lie.

plain: From 1959 to 1963 the CIA read Lee Harvey Oswald's mail, according to the researcher Jeremy Riss, through an operation tied to James Jesus Angleton, the agency's longtime counterintelligence chief, and to a man named Reuben Efron. Riss tells Michels that Efron appears in the JFK files, the government records released on the Kennedy assassination, and that when one figure was asked in those files whether he knew Efron, he said no. Riss calls that answer "a lie", which would mean the CIA was watching Oswald closely years before the assassination and later hid it.
